Review target: `3b732691..e2a45ef7`

`high effort → 8 inline angles → dedup (no verify) → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Find candidates (3 correctness angles + 3 cleanup angles + 1 altitude angle + 1 conventions angle, up to 6 each)

Run **8 independent finder angles** in sequence yourself, in THIS context — do NOT spawn subagents for them. Each
surfaces **up to 6 candidate findings** with `file`, `line`, a one-line
`summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change fixes the root cause at the right depth rather than
patching a symptom with a fragile bandaid. Special cases layered on shared
infrastructure are a sign the fix isn't deep enough — prefer the simpler, more
general change to the underlying mechanism over adding special cases, and name
that change.

### Conventions (CLAUDE.md)

Find the CLAUDE.md files that govern the changed code: the user-level
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo-root CLAUDE.md, plus any CLAUDE.md or
CLAUDE.local.md in a directory that is an ancestor of a changed file (a
directory's CLAUDE.md only applies to files at or below it). Read each one
that exists, then check the diff for clear violations of the rules they state.

Only flag a violation when you can quote the exact rule and the exact line
that breaks it — no style preferences, no vague "spirit of the doc"
inferences. In the finding, name the CLAUDE.md path and quote the rule so the
report can cite it. If no CLAUDE.md applies, return nothing for this angle.

Cleanup, altitude, and conventions candidates use the same
`file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in `failure_scenario`, state the concrete
cost (what is duplicated, wasted, harder to maintain, or which CLAUDE.md rule
is broken) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank cleanup,
altitude, and conventions findings when the output cap forces a cut.

Pass every candidate with a nameable failure scenario through — finders that
silently drop half-believed candidates are the dominant cause of misses.

## Phase 2 — Dedup only (no verify)

Pool all candidates. Dedup near-duplicates only (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one). Do NOT run verifiers; do NOT re-judge. Sort by severity.

## Output

Target **at least 5 findings**. If fewer genuine findings exist, emit what you have — do not invent to hit the floor.

Call the ReportFindings tool once to report this review's results
with `{level, findings}`. `findings` is at most 10 entries ranked
most-severe first; each entry has `file`, `line`, `summary`,
`short_summary` — the claim compressed to ≤60 characters, no rationale
or consequence clause — `failure_scenario`, and `category` — a short kebab-case slug for the angle
that produced it (`correctness`, `simplification`, `efficiency`,
`reuse`, `altitude`, `conventions`, or a more specific slug like
`test-coverage` when one fits better) — plus `verdict` when a verify pass
produced one. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most severe. If
nothing survives, call it with an empty array. Do not also print
the findings as text, and do not create or publish an artifact of the review -
the tool call is the report.


## If findings are fixed later

Whenever reported findings get fixed later in this session - the user asks you
to fix them, or later work fixes them incidentally - you MUST call ReportFindings again with the same findings, each
carrying an `outcome`: `fixed`, `no_change_needed` (the finding was wrong or
already handled), or `skipped` (real but not applied). Do not repeat the
findings as text.
Make that call immediately after the fixes land, before any prose summary; the
host UI's per-finding status updates only from it, and without it the findings
stay marked unresolved.

VERSION_TEXT = f"doc-structured {__version__}"


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="doc-structured",
        description="アプリケーションの文書の構成の、生成と検査のツール",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=VERSION_TEXT)
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", metavar="<サブコマンド>", required=True)
    subparsers.add_parser("version", help="ツールのバージョンを表示する")
    subparsers.add_parser("generate", help="ドメインの YAML から、人が読む Markdown を生成する")
    check_parser = subparsers.add_parser("check", help="検査を実行する。指定が無ければ軽い群 (--light)")
    group = check_parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    group.add_argument("--light", action="store_true", help=f"軽い群の検査 ({'・'.join(check.LIGHT)}) を実行する")
    group.add_argument("--heavy", action="store_true", help="重い群の検査を実行する")
    group.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="すべての検査を実行する")
    group.add_argument("--only", metavar="<検査>", help="1 つの検査だけを実行する (例 --only a)")
    return parser


def run_check(config: Config, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.only is not None:
        if args.only not in check.ALL:
            print(
                f"doc-structured: このバージョンのツールに検査 {args.only} は無い (ある検査: {'・'.join(check.ALL)})",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 2
        checks: tuple[str, ...] = (args.only,)
    elif args.heavy:

    elif args.all:
        checks = check.ALL
    else:
        checks = check.LIGHT
    if not checks:
        print("重い群の検査は、このバージョンのツールには無い")
        return 0
    result = check.run_checks(config.root, checks)
    for problem in result.problems:
        print(problem.format())
    names = "・".join(checks)
    if result.skipped:

    else:

    return 1

"""hook (スクリプト doc-structured/hook-scripts/guard-generated.py) のテスト。

Claude Code が PreToolUse の hook に渡す JSON を標準入力で渡し、生成したファイルへの Edit・Write・NotebookEdit を拒否すること、

"""

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import unittest

from doc_structured import generated_header as gh
from tooltest import PLUGIN_DIR, PYTHON, ProjectTestCase, clean_env

HOOK_SCRIPT = PLUGIN_DIR / "hook-scripts" / "guard-generated.py"
HOOKS_JSON = PLUGIN_DIR / "hooks" / "hooks.json"
MODELS = "docs/domains/02-loans/models.md"
HANDWRITTEN = "docs/domains/02-loans/concept.md"


class GuardGeneratedHookTest(ProjectTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        super().setUp()
        self.copy_sample()
        self.write(HANDWRITTEN, "# 貸出の概念\n\n手書きの文書。\n")

    def run_hook(self, tool_name: str, path: str, cwd=None):
        key = "notebook_path" if tool_name == "NotebookEdit" else "file_path"
        payload = {
            "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "tool_input": {key: path},
            "cwd": str(cwd or self.project),
        }
        return subprocess.run(
            [PYTHON, str(HOOK_SCRIPT)],
            input=json.dumps(payload),
            cwd=self.tmp,
            env=clean_env(),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )

    def assert_denied(self, result, source: str):
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        output = json.loads(result.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]
        self.assertEqual(output["hookEventName"], "PreToolUse")
        self.assertEqual(output["permissionDecision"], "deny")
        reason = output["permissionDecisionReason"]
        self.assertIn("生成したファイル", reason)
        self.assertIn(f"生成元 {source}", reason)
        self.assertIn("bin/doc-structured generate", reason)
        self.assertIn("doc-structured:generate", reason)
        return reason

    def assert_allowed(self, result):
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")

    def test_denies_edit_write_and_notebook_edit_of_generated_markdown(self):
        for tool_name in ("Edit", "Write", "NotebookEdit"):
            with self.subTest(tool=tool_name):
                reason = self.assert_denied(
                    self.run_hook(tool_name, str(self.project / MODELS)), "docs/domains/02-loans/"
                )
                self.assertIn(MODELS, reason)

    def test_denies_generated_gitattributes(self):
        self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Edit", str(self.project / "docs/.gitattributes")), "docs/domains/")

    def test_denies_generated_markdown_with_frontmatter(self):
        path = self.write(
            "docs/generated-with-frontmatter.md",
            "---\n" + gh.hash_line("docs/domains/02-loans/") + "\ntitle: x\n---\n\n# 本文\n",
        )
        self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Write", str(path)), "docs/domains/02-loans/")

    def test_relative_path_is_resolved_from_cwd(self):
        self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Edit", MODELS), "docs/domains/02-loans/")
        self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook("Edit", HANDWRITTEN))

    def test_reason_shows_relative_path_for_directory_starting_with_dots(self):
        # cwd の直下の、名前が「..」で始まるディレクトリは cwd の中なので、相対パスで示す
        path = self.write("..cache/generated.md", gh.markdown_line("docs/domains/02-loans/") + "\n# 本文\n")
        reason = self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Edit", str(path)), "docs/domains/02-loans/")
        self.assertTrue(reason.startswith("..cache/generated.md は "), reason)
        # cwd の外のファイルは絶対パスで示す
        outside = self.tmp / "outside.md"
        outside.write_text(gh.markdown_line("docs/domains/02-loans/") + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        reason = self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Edit", str(outside)), "docs/domains/02-loans/")
        self.assertTrue(reason.startswith(f"{outside} は "), reason)

    def test_allows_handwritten_files(self):
        for tool_name in ("Edit", "Write"):
            with self.subTest(tool=tool_name):
                self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook(tool_name, str(self.project / HANDWRITTEN)))
        # 先頭の 3 行より後に先頭の記述と同じ文字列があっても、生成したファイルではない
        path = self.write("docs/notes.md", "# メモ\n\n説明\n" + gh.markdown_line("docs/domains/") + "\n")
        self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook("Edit", str(path)))

    def test_allows_writing_new_file(self):
        self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook("Write", str(self.project / "docs/domains/02-loans/design.md")))

    def test_allows_input_without_path(self):
        self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook("Edit", ""))

    def test_works_without_project_config(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.project / ".claude")
        self.assert_denied(self.run_hook("Edit", str(self.project / MODELS)), "docs/domains/02-loans/")
        self.assert_allowed(self.run_hook("Edit", str(self.project / HANDWRITTEN)))

    def test_invalid_input_is_reported_without_deciding(self):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [PYTHON, str(HOOK_SCRIPT)], input="{", cwd=self.tmp, env=clean_env(), capture_output=True, text=True
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        self.assertIn("doc-structured:", result.stderr)

    def test_registered_as_pre_tool_use_hook(self):
        hooks = json.loads(HOOKS_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["hooks"]
        self.assertEqual(list(hooks), ["PreToolUse"])
        [entry] = hooks["PreToolUse"]
        self.assertEqual(entry["matcher"], "Edit|Write|NotebookEdit")
        [command] = entry["hooks"]
        self.assertEqual(command["type"], "command")
        self.assertEqual(command["command"], 'python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook-scripts/guard-generated.py"')

"""生成するファイル docs/.gitattributes (生成したファイルの merge の設定) のテスト。

docs/.gitattributes は、ディレクトリ docs/ の下の生成したファイルに、git の組み込みの merge driver binary を設定する。
生成したファイルが競合したマージとリベースの後に、git が ours とする側 (merge では現在のブランチ、rebase では引数に指定したブランチ) の
内容が競合のマーク無しで残り、generate で生成し直すと正しい内容になることを、一時的な git のリポジトリで確認する。
"""

import subprocess
import unittest

from doc_structured import generated_header as gh
from doc_structured.domains import load_project
from doc_structured.generate import GITATTRIBUTES_PATH, generated_files, render_project
from tooltest import PYTHON, SAMPLE_PROJECT, ProjectTestCase, clean_env

TERMS_FILE = "docs/domains/01-catalog/unclassified_app_terms.md"


def term_yaml(name: str, name_ja: str, definition: str) -> str:
    return f"unclassified_app_terms:\n  {name}:\n    name_ja: {name_ja}\n    definition: {definition}\n"


class GitattributesTest(ProjectTestCase):
    def run_tool(self, *args: str):
        return subprocess.run(
            [PYTHON, "-m", "doc_structured", *args], cwd=self.project, env=clean_env(), capture_output=True, text=True
        )

    def git(self, *args: str, check: bool = True):
        # 利用者の git の設定 (merge.*.driver など) が結果を変えないよう、全体とシステムの設定を読ませない
        env = clean_env(
            GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="/dev/null",
            GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
            GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="test",
            GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="test@example.com",
            GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="test",
            GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="test@example.com",
        )
        result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=self.project, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if check:
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, f"git {' '.join(args)}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}")
        return result

    def test_lists_every_generated_file_with_binary_merge_driver(self):
        project, problems = load_project(SAMPLE_PROJECT)
        self.assertEqual(problems, [])
        outputs = render_project(project)
        content = outputs[GITATTRIBUTES_PATH]
        lines = content.splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(lines[0], gh.hash_line("docs/domains/"))
        self.assertEqual(gh.read_header(content), gh.Header(source="docs/domains/", command=gh.GENERATE_COMMAND))
        patterns = [line for line in lines if not line.startswith("#")]
        # docs/.gitattributes 自身を含む、すべての生成したファイル。パスは docs/ からの相対で、先頭に「/」を付ける
        expected = [f"/{path.removeprefix('docs/')} merge=binary" for path in sorted(outputs)]
        self.assertEqual(patterns, expected)
        self.assertIn("/.gitattributes merge=binary", patterns)
        self.assertIn("/glossary.md merge=binary", patterns)

    def test_is_treated_as_generated_file(self):
        self.assertIn(GITATTRIBUTES_PATH, generated_files(SAMPLE_PROJECT))

    def test_not_generated_without_any_domain(self):
        self.write(".claude/akm-claude-plugins/doc-structured/config.yaml", "version: 0.3.0\n")
        project, problems = load_project(self.project)
        self.assertEqual(problems, [])
        self.assertEqual(render_project(project), {})

    def test_check_a_reports_hand_edited_gitattributes(self):
        self.copy_sample()
        path = self.project / GITATTRIBUTES_PATH
        path.write_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "/domains/01-catalog/concept.md merge=binary\n", encoding="utf-8")
        result = self.run_tool("check", "--only", "a")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn(f"{GITATTRIBUTES_PATH}: 検査 a: 生成し直した内容と違う。", result.stdout)

    def test_check_a_passes_after_generate(self):
        self.copy_sample()
        (self.project / GITATTRIBUTES_PATH).unlink()
        self.assertEqual(self.run_tool("check", "--only", "a").returncode, 1)
        result = self.run_tool("generate")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"書いた: {GITATTRIBUTES_PATH}", result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_tool("check", "--only", "a").returncode, 0)

    def make_conflicting_branches(self) -> None:
        """2 つのブランチ main と other が、同じドメインの別の YAML のファイルに未分類の用語を足す。
        YAML は競合しないが、生成したファイル unclassified_app_terms.md は同じ位置に足されて競合する。最後は main にいる。"""
        self.copy_sample()
        self.git("init", "--quiet", "--initial-branch=main")
        self.git("add", "--all")
        self.git("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "サンプルのプロジェクト")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.git("check-attr", "merge", TERMS_FILE).stdout.strip(), f"{TERMS_FILE}: merge: binary"
        )
        self.git("switch", "--quiet", "--create", "other")
        self.write("docs/domains/01-catalog/other/terms.yaml", term_yaml("isbn", "国際標準図書番号", "図書を識別する番号。"))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_tool("generate").returncode, 0)
        self.git("add", "--all")
        self.git("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "other")
        self.git("switch", "--quiet", "main")
        self.write("docs/domains/01-catalog/main/terms.yaml", term_yaml("spine_label", "背ラベル", "図書の背に貼るラベル。"))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_tool("generate").returncode, 0)
        self.git("add", "--all")
        self.git("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "main")

    def assert_conflicts_keep(self, kept_rev: str) -> None:
        """競合したのは生成したファイルだけで、kept_rev の内容が競合のマーク無しで残っている。"""
        conflicted = self.git("diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=U").stdout.split()
        self.assertIn(TERMS_FILE, conflicted)
        for path in conflicted:
            with self.subTest(file=path):
                self.assertIn(path, generated_files(self.project))
                actual = (self.project / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertNotIn("<<<<<<<", actual)
                self.assertEqual(actual, self.git("show", f"{kept_rev}:{path}").stdout)

    def assert_generate_resolves(self) -> None:
        result = self.run_tool("generate")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        terms = (self.project / TERMS_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("国際標準図書番号", terms)
        self.assertIn("背ラベル", terms)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_tool("check").returncode, 0)
        self.git("add", "--all")
        self.assertEqual(self.git("diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=U").stdout, "")

    def test_merge_conflict_keeps_current_branch_and_generate_fixes_it(self):
        self.make_conflicting_branches()
        merge = self.git("merge", "--no-edit", "other", check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(merge.returncode, 0, merge.stdout)
        # git merge では、現在のブランチ (main) の内容が残る
        self.assert_conflicts_keep("main")
        self.assert_generate_resolves()
        self.git("commit", "--quiet", "--no-edit")

    def test_rebase_conflict_keeps_upstream_and_generate_fixes_it(self):
        self.make_conflicting_branches()
        self.git("switch", "--quiet", "other")
        rebase = self.git("rebase", "main", check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(rebase.returncode, 0, rebase.stdout)
        # git rebase では、引数に指定したブランチ (main) の内容が残る。リベースしているブランチ (other) の内容ではない
        self.assert_conflicts_keep("main")
        self.assert_generate_resolves()
        self.git("-c", "core.editor=true", "rebase", "--continue")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
